nodes.label: FIFO point ledger loyalty program вЂ” earn/redeem rates (loyaltyExchangeRate default 10, loyaltyRedeemRate default 150), Silver/Gold VIP tiers (500/2000 point thresholds), Happy Hour multipliers (Math.max with tier, not additive), expiry reminder cron at midnight UTC, timezone-aware via Luxon
nodes.rationale: Most heavily modified subsystem. 5 bugs fixed in May 2026 rewrite (FIFO ledger, configurable VIP tiers, 5 more bugs May 3 audit). Rated 98/100.

nodes.label: loyalty-tiers.utils.ts вЂ” getTierInfo() and tierConfigFromRestaurant(), never hardcode thresholds (500/2000) anywhere
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for tier info; thresholds read from Restaurant row, not hardcoded

nodes.label: loyalty-ledger.utils.ts вЂ” FIFO operations: expireAccountPoints, redeemAccountPoints, addEarnedPointBatch, getExpiringPointBatches(onlyUnnotified), markRemindersSent. Critical rule: never Promise.all inside $transaction
nodes.rationale: Promise.all inside $transaction causes race conditions; use updateMany instead

nodes.label: Loyalty rate semantics вЂ” loyaltyExchangeRate (Int, default 10): points earned per 1 spent; loyaltyRedeemRate (Int, default 150): points needed for 1 discount; effective cashback = earnRate/redeemRate * 100, defaults give 6.7%
nodes.rationale: @Max(100) enforced on loyaltyExchangeRate; initial migration had DEFAULT 20, corrected to 10 in migration 20260503200750
